### What We Do

#### Global Botanical Ingredient Supply Solutions

ACPFOOD is a Global Botanical Ingredient Supply Solutions Provider, serving importers,
manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors, and industrial buyers across the food, pharmaceutical,
cosmetic, fragrance, nutraceutical, and beverage industries.

As a medicinal herbs and natural products exporter and wholesale supplier, we provide premium
botanical ingredients, including medicinal herbs, natural resins, gums, dried flowers, seeds, dried
fruits, manna products, minerals, gemstones, and other carefully selected natural products.

With global distribution through our partners in Canada and China, we ensure consistent quality,
reliable logistics, and efficient delivery for every order.

For bulk orders exceeding 1 metric ton, we offer reliable international shipping and customs
documentation to support efficient delivery worldwide. Customers in North America and East Asia also
benefit from our fulfillment partners in Toronto and Nanjing, ensuring smooth and dependable access
to our botanical ingredients and natural products.

### Our Customers

#### Industries We Serve with Medicinal Herbs and Natural Products

ACPFOOD is a trusted medicinal herbs and natural products exporter serving B2B customers including
manufacturers, wholesalers, importers, distributors, retailers, brand owners, and industrial buyers
across global markets. As a supplier of bulk botanical ingredients and natural products, we support
businesses seeking reliable sourcing, consistent quality, and efficient international logistics.

Our products are supplied to a wide range of industries, including pharmaceuticals, nutraceuticals,
herbal medicines, food and beverage manufacturing (including both soft and alcoholic beverages),
herbal teas, cosmetics and personal care, perfumery and fragrances, aromatherapy, incense
production, plant extract manufacturing, hydrosols, veterinary products, natural pesticides,
agricultural formulations, confectionery, functional foods, and other industrial applications
requiring premium botanical ingredients and natural raw materials.

### What We Do

#### Global Botanical Ingredient Supply Solutions

ACPFOOD is a Global Botanical Ingredient Supply Solutions Provider, serving importers,
manufacturers, wholesalers, distributors, and industrial buyers across the food, pharmaceutical,
cosmetic, fragrance, nutraceutical, and beverage industries.

As a medicinal herbs and natural products exporter and wholesale supplier, we provide premium
botanical ingredients, including medicinal herbs, natural resins, gums, dried flowers, seeds, dried
fruits, manna products, minerals, gemstones, and other carefully selected natural products.

With global distribution through our partners in Canada and China, we ensure consistent quality,
reliable logistics, and efficient delivery for every order.

For bulk orders exceeding 1 metric ton, we offer reliable international shipping and customs
documentation to support efficient delivery worldwide. Customers in North America and East Asia also
benefit from our fulfillment partners in Toronto and Nanjing, ensuring smooth and dependable access
to our botanical ingredients and natural products.

### Our Customers

#### Industries We Serve with Medicinal Herbs and Natural Products

ACPFOOD is a trusted medicinal herbs and natural products exporter serving B2B customers including
manufacturers, wholesalers, importers, distributors, retailers, brand owners, and industrial buyers
across global markets. As a supplier of bulk botanical ingredients and natural products, we support
businesses seeking reliable sourcing, consistent quality, and efficient international logistics.

Our products are supplied to a wide range of industries, including pharmaceuticals, nutraceuticals,
herbal medicines, food and beverage manufacturing (including both soft and alcoholic beverages),
herbal teas, cosmetics and personal care, perfumery and fragrances, aromatherapy, incense
production, plant extract manufacturing, hydrosols, veterinary products, natural pesticides,
agricultural formulations, confectionery, functional foods, and other industrial applications
requiring premium botanical ingredients and natural raw materials.

CCOF is a nonprofit organization that advances organic agriculture for a healthy world through
organic certification, education, advocacy, and promotion. We envision a world where organic is the
norm.

[ Get Certified ][171] [ Donate ][172]

From field to fork, we're growing a future where organic is the norm.

## Supporting Organic Professionals

## Getting Started

We are your partner as you navigate the complicated world of organic certification.

[ Get Certified ][173]

## Staying Certified

Use our Resource Library, MyCCOF portal, videos, podcasts, and more.

[ Resources ][174]

## Advocating for You

We keep you in the loop on policy updates and represent organic producers at the state and national
levels.

[ Advocacy ][175]

## Grants

The CCOF Foundation offers financial support for students, farmers transitioning to organic, and
producers facing hardship.

[ Grants ][176]

## Interested in going organic?

### Join our free weekly Organic Office Hours to learn everything about transitioning to organic,
### staying in compliance & more. All questions & experience levels welcome!

[ Learn More! ][177]

## Why Organic?

Organic creates jobs, sequesters carbon, keeps water clean, and reduces our exposure to toxic
pesticides. Learn about the economic, social, and environmental benefits of organic.

producers and handlers.

# Agricultural Products Manufacturers, Supplier & Exporters in India

**CMS Industries **is the leading agricultural products manufacturers, supplier & exporter in India.
Indian Spices, Animal Feed, pulses, grains, wide range of oil seeds. We leading exporter and
supplier of an assortment of Agricultural products from India. India is one of the largest
Agriculture producers across the globe, so we exist to pivot the farmers from all over the country.
**CMS INDUSTRIES** is located in Kachchh, Gujarat, well established since two decades. We are known
for our quality and higher nutrition-content supplies of our diverse range of products that include
***Indian Spices, Grains, Animal Feed, Herbs, Pulses and wide range of oil seeds***. Since the
commencement, our journey has been growing in leaps and establishing itself in the renowned Global
market as an accountable and sustainable International supplier.

### Vision

To be Asia’s most customer-centric company, where customers can select and buy premium Agro
commodities.

### Mission

We strive to offer our customers the superior Agro commodities at the lowest possible prices with
the utmost convenience.

## Our Products Agro Products

Our customers receive healthy lifestyle choices through our range of organically derived products.
CMS Industries produces organic agricultural products and operates in India. We recognize the
farmers’ hard work and make sure they obtain their equitable portion of the profits. We ethically
source our global exports of organic Rice, Oil Seeds, Grains, Spices, Pulses, and Herbs. Explore our
collection of natural agricultural products to find what best matches your needs.

****Ready to love your garden again?****

**I help frustrated gardeners grow smarter to create beautiful and highly productive gardens that

exhausting.

You want clarity on what matters and a system that works in YOUR garden.

**That’s exactly what I’m here for**.

[GROW A THRIVING GARDEN][9]
[Amy's beautiful vegetable garden.]

## Is This Where You’re At Right Now?

✅

You’re capable and hard-working. You know your garden can thrive. You’ve put in the time, the care,
and the heart. And yet, you often feel stuck and frustrated trying to make it all work.

✅

You’re confident with some things, but guessing with others. Your garden starts out strong, but it’s
chaotic by mid-summer, and it seems like you’re constantly fighting one thing after another.

✅

You understand the basics. You’ve had some wins. But your garden feels like it’s hit-or-miss – some
years are better than others, and you just can’t seem to get consistent results.

✅

You know how you want your garden to look. You can picture it in your head. But it isn’t turning out
that way, and it feels like a hot mess that stresses you out every time you look at it.

✅

You’re ready for gardening to feel easier and more consistent. You crave a system that actually
works in YOUR garden, right now, so you can get excited to go outside and enjoy it again.

**Then you’re in the right place!**

Hey there, I’m Amy Andrychowicz

[Picture of Amy Andrychowicz in front of her flower garden.]

I spent years struggling and spinning my wheels, desperately trying to make my garden work.

The more I fought to fix ALL of the problems, the harder it became to manage my garden – and I just
kept thinking: “There’s *got* to be a better way!”.

Once I stopped fighting *against* my garden and focused on working *smarter* to create a healthy
environment that supported strong, resilient plants, everything clicked into place – and my garden
started to thrive on it’s own.

I’ll help you make that same shift in your garden, so you can skip the painful trial & error and
create a beautiful, highly productive garden that you love.

[MORE ABOUT AMY][10]

**Stop fighting against your garden, and create one that practically takes care of itself!**

I’m here to help you shift away from *fighting* all of the problems as they pop up in your garden to
*working smarter* to create a healthy environment where plants can thrive.

Because once the bugs, weeds and diseases show up in your garden, it’s very hard to get rid of them
– and once your plants start to struggle, it’s often too late to save them.

**The smarter approach** is to create a *balanced* garden *ecosystem* that works with *nature* to
*prevent* problems before they start, and supports strong, resilient plants that can defend
themselves.

Let me show you my proven system for making this shift to growing smarter so your success is
inevitable and you can *love* your garden again.

## Your Gardening Success Cycle

When your garden’s ecosystem is balanced, it supports strong, resilient plants that can naturally
resist problems, so it practically takes care of itself.

That’s why I created the *Garden Growth Framework*™. A simple, repeatable, step-by-step system for
growing a thriving, low-maintenance garden you love.

## Here’s the strategy that actually works in YOUR garden:

[S1 Planning feature image of my vegetable garden layout.]

## Step 1: Planning

This is all about properly planning and designing your garden and choosing the best plants that will
thrive there, so not only will it *look* good, it’s set up the *right* way to prevent problems from
the start.

[S2 Planting feature image of Amy planting a shrub.]

## Step 2: Planting

Here’s where you’ll lay the foundation of your balanced ecosystem by prepping your soil and
installing everything correctly so your garden supports strong roots and healthy plant growth.

[S3 Nurturing feature image of Amy under her signature squash arch.]

## Step 3: Nurturing

This is all about caring for your plants in a way that improves growth, prevents problems before
they start, and strengthens your garden’s delicate ecosystem, instead of harming it or throwing it
out of whack.

[S4 Fixing feature image of row covers installed over garden plants.]

## A family run herb farm with over 40 years’ experience in sustainably growing and using medicinal
## and culinary herb plants and seeds.

[
][173]

### Jekka's Herb Farm

Jekka’s is home to the largest collection of culinary herbs in the UK. A family run herb farm on the
outskirts of Bristol with over 40 years’ experience in sustainably growing and using medicinal &
culinary herbs, both plants and seeds. You can visit Jekka's Herb Farm for one of our [**herb
experiences**][174] or during an [**open day**][175]. Please see our [**events calendar**][176] for
dates.

[ Read our story ][177]
[
][178]

### Jekka's Online Herb Shop

Jekka's is continually growing with the development of [**master classes**][179], [**herb seed
collections**][180], a range of illustrated gifts, [**gardener gift boxes**][181], [**grow at home
herb kits**][182] and [**Jekka's herbal infusions**][183]. All available in Jekka's [**online herb
shop**][184]. All our products follow our root of being ‘*green, environmentally friendly and
sustainable*'.

[ Shop now ][185]
[
][186]

### Jekka's Herb Experiences

Jekka’s aim to educate and inspire gardeners and cooks of all ages. Jekka’s offer a variety of
[**herb experiences**][187] from [**open days**][188] to [**master classes**][189] based
around Jekka’s Herbetum. Spend the day at Jekka's and discover our passion for growing sustainable
culinary and medicinal herbs. All herbs are grown following organic principals (read about [**our
approach**][190]).

[ Read more ][191]

Living book of Herbs

A New Chapter at Jekka's

After more than forty years of growing herbs, Jekka's is entering a new chapter.

While we have stepped back from large-scale plant production, our passion for herbs remains
unchanged. Our focus is now on sharing knowledge and inspiring gardeners through Jekka's Herb
Garden, the Herbetum, herb experiences, talks, books and our carefully curated range of seeds and
products.

We look forward to welcoming you to discover, learn and celebrate the wonderful world of herbs with
us.


[ Read more ][192]
[
][193]
[
][194]

Back by popular demand! Available to buy online.

Jekka's Herbal Infusions

Jekka’s herbal teas are a perfect blend of herbs that make the ultimate tisane. They have been
lovingly created based on over 40 years’ experience of growing and using herbs on Jekka’s award
winning herb farm.

Jekka's herbal infusion blends are:
* [**Citrus Trilogy**][195]: A refreshing blend of lemon, lime and orange blossom
* [**Mint Fiesta**][196]: an aromatic blend of mint and fennel
* [**Eastern Promise**][197]: Jekka’s Chai, caffeine free, herb and spice infusion
* [**Bright & Breezy**][198]: An exhilarating aromatic blend of green tea, mint and marigold petals
* [**Summer Garden**][199]: A light floral blend of lemon verbena and elderflower

[ Buy now ][200]

Safeguarding horticultural knowledge

Jekka’s Hosts HORTISTRY

Jekka’s was delighted to host the first HORTISTRY propagation master class on the 18th April.

HORTISTRY brings together leading horticulturists to share essential growing skills with practising
horticultural professionals.

Rooted in our new chapter and long tradition of education, this initiative helps safeguard the
specialist knowledge that underpins great horticulture and supports the next generation of
professional growers and gardeners across the UK.

Read more through the link below

[ Read more ][201]
[
][202]
[
][203]

Love Your weekend

Wedding Flowers & Herbs: As Seen on Love Your Weekend

Appearing on ITV's *Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh* on 31 May 2026, Jekka celebrated the
flavour, fragrance and beauty of herbs and edible flowers.

Discover the recipes showcased on the programme, including Elderflower Cordial, [**Heartsease Ice
Cubes**][204] and Herb Cream Cheese & [**Griddled Flatbread Circles**][205], and bring a little
herb-inspired creativity to your own table.

][173]

### Jekka's Herb Farm

Jekka’s is home to the largest collection of culinary herbs in the UK. A family run herb farm on the
outskirts of Bristol with over 40 years’ experience in sustainably growing and using medicinal &
culinary herbs, both plants and seeds. You can visit Jekka's Herb Farm for one of our [**herb
experiences**][174] or during an [**open day**][175]. Please see our [**events calendar**][176] for
dates.

[ Read our story ][177]
[
][178]

### Jekka's Online Herb Shop

Jekka's is continually growing with the development of [**master classes**][179], [**herb seed
collections**][180], a range of illustrated gifts, [**gardener gift boxes**][181], [**grow at home
herb kits**][182] and [**Jekka's herbal infusions**][183]. All available in Jekka's [**online herb
shop**][184]. All our products follow our root of being ‘*green, environmentally friendly and
sustainable*'.

[ Shop now ][185]
[
][186]

### Jekka's Herb Experiences

Jekka’s aim to educate and inspire gardeners and cooks of all ages. Jekka’s offer a variety of
[**herb experiences**][187] from [**open days**][188] to [**master classes**][189] based
around Jekka’s Herbetum. Spend the day at Jekka's and discover our passion for growing sustainable
culinary and medicinal herbs. All herbs are grown following organic principals (read about [**our
approach**][190]).

[ Read more ][191]

Living book of Herbs

A New Chapter at Jekka's

After more than forty years of growing herbs, Jekka's is entering a new chapter.

While we have stepped back from large-scale plant production, our passion for herbs remains
unchanged. Our focus is now on sharing knowledge and inspiring gardeners through Jekka's Herb
Garden, the Herbetum, herb experiences, talks, books and our carefully curated range of seeds and
products.

We look forward to welcoming you to discover, learn and celebrate the wonderful world of herbs with
us.


[ Read more ][192]
[
][193]
[
][194]

Back by popular demand! Available to buy online.

Jekka's Herbal Infusions

Jekka’s herbal teas are a perfect blend of herbs that make the ultimate tisane. They have been
lovingly created based on over 40 years’ experience of growing and using herbs on Jekka’s award
winning herb farm.

Jekka's herbal infusion blends are:
* [**Citrus Trilogy**][195]: A refreshing blend of lemon, lime and orange blossom
* [**Mint Fiesta**][196]: an aromatic blend of mint and fennel
* [**Eastern Promise**][197]: Jekka’s Chai, caffeine free, herb and spice infusion
* [**Bright & Breezy**][198]: An exhilarating aromatic blend of green tea, mint and marigold petals
* [**Summer Garden**][199]: A light floral blend of lemon verbena and elderflower

[ Buy now ][200]

Safeguarding horticultural knowledge

Jekka’s Hosts HORTISTRY

Jekka’s was delighted to host the first HORTISTRY propagation master class on the 18th April.

HORTISTRY brings together leading horticulturists to share essential growing skills with practising
horticultural professionals.

Rooted in our new chapter and long tradition of education, this initiative helps safeguard the
specialist knowledge that underpins great horticulture and supports the next generation of
professional growers and gardeners across the UK.

Read more through the link below

Love Your weekend

Wedding Flowers & Herbs: As Seen on Love Your Weekend

Appearing on ITV's *Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh* on 31 May 2026, Jekka celebrated the
flavour, fragrance and beauty of herbs and edible flowers.

Discover the recipes showcased on the programme, including Elderflower Cordial, [**Heartsease Ice
Cubes**][204] and Herb Cream Cheese & [**Griddled Flatbread Circles**][205], and bring a little
herb-inspired creativity to your own table.

Jekka's Blog Posts

Explore a treasure trove of herb wisdom! From seasonal “How to Grow” guides—such as [**autumn
maintenance**][226] tips and [**late-spring**][227] care advice - to inspirational posts including
“[**Top 10 Herbs as Houseplants**][228]” or how to rewilding your herb garden for biodiversity.
You’ll also find deep dives into herb families such as “[**All About Alliums**][229]” plus regular
year-in-review and seasonal highlights across the year

Whether you're a seasoned gardener or just herb-curious, Jekka's blog "All about Herbs" cultivates

At **KAPADIYA EXPO COMPANY**, we take pride in being one of the **world’s most trusted names in
agricultural and food exports**. With decades of expertise and a strong global presence, we
specialize in offering a **wide range of pure and natural food ingredients**—including **[Whole
Spices][25] & [Ground Spices][26], [Dehydrated Vegetables][27],[ Oil Seeds][28], [Fresh
Vegetables][29], [Herbal Product,][30] [Pulses][31], [Grains][32] & [Spray Dried Fruits][33]. **

shelf life**, ensuring exceptional taste and quality in every shipment. We maintain strict **quality
assurance and hygiene standards** at every stage—from sourcing to processing and packaging—to
preserve the **authentic Indian flavor and freshness** our customers love.

Backed by a robust supply chain and customer-first approach, **Kapadiya Expo Company** continues to
expand its footprint across **Asia, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Americas**, serving
leading importers, distributors, and food brands around the world.

to **quality, purity, and consistency** has made us a **trusted global manufacturer and exporter**
in the industry. Every product we offer reflects our passion for excellence — making **Kapadiya Expo
Company** the **first choice for quality-conscious buyers worldwide**.

automated packaging technology** to ensure maximum freshness, purity, and safety. Our **advanced

**export-quality standards** throughout the supply chain — delivering products that stay **fresh,
clean, and ready for global markets**.

## About True Leaf Market

For over 50 years, True Leaf Market has been committed to delivering the highest quality non-GMO
seeds to growers worldwide. Through our [Seeds By Design, links to external site][88] division in
Maxwell, California, we produce several million pounds of seed each year to support the home garden
seed industry.

Our expansive warehouse in Salt Lake City, Utah, allows us to efficiently manage and fulfill orders
quickly. Whether you're growing microgreens, wheatgrass, fruits, vegetables, or sprouts, you can
rely on our team for super-premium seeds that boost vigor and health.

## Vegetable Seeds

### 2,400+ Varieties

True Leaf Market offers one of the largest selections of vegetable and fruit seeds in the industry.
Every seed type can be ordered in convenient garden packets for home growers or in bulk and
wholesale quantities for farms, greenhouses, and commercial producers.

Our catalog includes everything from classic, time-tested garden vegetable seeds to rare, heirloom,
hybrid, and specialty seed varieties you won’t find anywhere else.

We have the largest online selection of amaranth, arugula, Chinese cabbage, cucumber, eggplant,
lettuce, melon, pea, radish, summer squash, winter squash, watermelon seeds, and more.

## About Us

Kisan Agro is an organization that specializes in manufacturing and exporting a variety of organic
food products like seeds, spices, grains, dry fruits, and pulses. Kisan Agro carved a niche in its
field by adopting a six-tier approach to Total Quality Management (TQM).

## Our History

Kisan Agro began its quest 20 years back and our aim was crystal clear since the beginning – ‘To
become a pioneer of organic across the globe’. The initial phase was tough for us as the Indian
market was completely unaware of this concept but we took it upon us to train & educate people about
organic products. We constantly kept updating our knowledge to devise the best organic goods for our
clientele.

Ours was the first company to venture in the business of manufacturing & trading agricultural
products and we also carved a niche in this field by adopting a six-tier approach for Total Quality
Management (TQM). Owing to our unique approach to organic farming we have built a solid reputation
across the globe as a trustworthy brand.

At present, we are one of the leading manufacturers of organic & conventional seeds, spices, grains,
cereals & pulses.

[viral-homepage-infra-banner]

## Infrastructure

At Kisan Agro, every possible effort is taken to secure unparalleled quality of the products. We are
backed by a strong infrastructure that helps us in manufacturing & exporting superior quality
products.

Powered by our proficient R & D team, we have a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility spread over
60,000 sq ft. Our manufacturing plant is located at Unjha (Gujarat), the heart of India’s seeds and
spices market; this enables us to get the fresh produce at the best price.

Our manufacturing facilities are equipped with high-end machinery such as an automatic hulling and
drying system, an Optical Z-3 Sortex system by Buhler,
De-stoner, Classifiers & Gravity Machine & Metal Detector that ensures the best possible purity of
our products.

Case Study

### EU Functional Beverage Brand

A European functional beverage brand approached Wana to develop a sparkling prebiotic soda and
collagen drink line for the German and Dutch retail market. Wana's R&D team completed initial
samples within 10 days, handled BRCGS-compatible documentation, and managed EU import compliance.
The brand launched 3 SKUs within 11 weeks of first contact, with a recurring quarterly order of 2
containers per SKU.

Case Study

### Retail Private Label Chain

A US retail chain needed a reliable private label beverage supplier for their in-house brand across
coconut water and aloe vera categories. After a trial order of 1×20ft container, they scaled to a
monthly supply agreement covering 8 SKUs across 3 categories. Wana managed full label design
adaptation, local regulatory documentation, and consistent batch color and taste across 12
consecutive shipments.

Case Study

### Middle East Distributor

A UAE-based food distributor required a HALAL-certified coconut water and juice portfolio for
distribution across Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and Bahrain. Wana developed 5 formulas with Arabic-language
label support, obtained HALAL certification for each SKU, and coordinated Gulfood exhibition
sampling. The distributor signed a 12-month supply agreement covering 6 containers per month.
